For every one of your products, Lystes recruits an AI sales advisor, trained on your product pages and your company, that gets better with every interaction and refines its answers based on what converts best. t039_peu-de-visiteurs-lisent-vos-fi: Few visitors read your product pages in full; they want a precise answer before buying. A dedicated advisor for each product gives it to them, and triggers the sale, 24/7.
t043_les-diagnostics-en-ligne-sont-: Almost every online diagnostic is a quiz: the customer answers what they think. Our diagnostic agents run a real biometric analysis of skin and hair, and recommend the right product, like in a clinic.
t046_une-bonne-photo-cr-e-l-motion-: A great photo creates emotion, and many AI visuals lack it. Ours rival the best photographers, and better: send us a mood board and we create your own house photographer, who will always shoot in your style.
t049_en-v-nement-impossible-de-bien: At events, it's impossible to properly advise every visitor in a crowd. Your AI teams handle it: diagnostic, virtual try-on or advice for each attendee. You leave with qualified leads and data.
t052_un-bon-plan-marketing-suppose-: A good marketing plan requires knowing your customers by heart. Lystes tells you exactly what yours looks like: age, expectations, objections, cross-referenced with your sales. Tailor-made, not a template.
t055_l-ugc-cr-e-la-proximit-mais-un: UGC builds closeness, but content that feels obviously AI has the opposite effect. Ours are undetectable and natural, a way to scale your production without casting or shoots.

t066_beaucoup-ma-trisent-le-seo-pou: Many master SEO for Google. Our agents also optimize for ChatGPT, where your customers already search, and ground every page in their real questions, from conversations with the product experts, to sell, not just rank.
